name: psxdecomp
description: Bootstrap a PlayStation matching-decompilation repository on Project Architect 3.14.2 and the decomp-architect kit: interview, disc identification, prior-art research, a pinned reference library, then the two pinned installers.

python_path.title: Python interpreter
python_path.description: Absolute path of a Python >= 3.12 for the game repo's hooks; empty = detected per machine.

kit_path.title: decomp-architect kit folder
kit_path.description: Optional: a local decomp-architect kit folder to use instead of the pinned one psxdecomp fetches (digest-checked).

docker_host.title: Docker host recipe
docker_host.description: Which host recipe the profile uses: macos-arm64 or linux-amd64; empty = detected.
